title: Exploring the molecular mechanism of hepatitis virus inducing hepatocellular carcinoma by microarray data and immune infiltrates analysis.
authors: Zhang, Yong-Zheng; Zeb, Amir; Cheng, Lu-Feng
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过微阵列数据和免疫浸润分析探索肝炎病毒诱导肝细胞癌的分子机制，虽提及转录因子调控但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The number of new cases of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) worldwide reached 910,000, ranking the sixth, 80% HCC is associated with viruses, so exploring the molecular mechanism of viral carcinogenicity is imperative. The study showed that both HBV and HCV associated HCC and non-viral HCC have the same molecular phenotype (low gene expression and inhibition of immune pathways), but in the tumor immune micro-environment, there is excessive M2-type macrophage polarization in virus-associated hepatocellular carcinoma. To address this phenomenon, the data sets were analyzed and identified five hub genes (POLR2A, POLR2B, RPL5, RPS6, RPL23A) involved in viral gene expression and associated with PI3K-Akt-mTOR pathway activation by six algorithms. In addition, numerous studies have reported that M2-type macrophages participate in the hepatic fibro-pathological process of the development of HCC and are regulated by the PI3K-Akt-mTOR pathway. On this basis, the study showed that hepatitis virus causes abnormal expression of hub genes, leading to the activation of the pathway, which in turn promote the differentiation of M2-type macrophages and eventually promote the formation of liver fibrosis, leading to the occurrence of HCC. In addition, these hub genes are regulated by transcription factors and m(6)A enzyme, and have good prognosis and diagnostic value. With regard to drug reuse, the results suggest that patients with virus-related HCC for whom Cytidine triphosphate disodium salt and Guanosine-5'-Triphosphate are used as supplementary therapy, and may have a better prognosis. In conclusion, the study has identified novel molecules that are carcinogenic to hepatitis viruses and are expected to serve as molecular markers and targets for diagnosis and treatment.
abstract_zh: 全球范围内肝细胞癌（HCC）新发病例数已达91万例，位居第六位，其中80%的HCC与病毒相关，因此探索病毒致癌性的分子机制势在必行。研究表明，HBV和HCV相关的HCC与非病毒性HCC具有相同的分子表型（低基因表达和免疫通路抑制），但在肿瘤免疫微环境中，病毒相关肝细胞癌存在过度的M2型巨噬细胞极化现象。针对这一现象，通过分析数据集并运用六种算法，鉴定出五个参与病毒基因表达且与PI3K-Akt-mTOR通路激活相关的枢纽基因（POLR2A、POLR2B、RPL5、RPS6、RPL23A）。此外，大量研究报道M2型巨噬细胞参与HCC发生发展的肝纤维化病理过程，并受PI3K-Akt-mTOR通路调控。在此基础上，研究表明肝炎病毒导致枢纽基因异常表达，进而激活该通路，从而促进M2型巨噬细胞分化，最终促进肝纤维化形成，导致HCC的发生。此外，这些枢纽基因受转录因子和m(6)A酶调控，具有良好的预后和诊断价值。在药物再利用方面，结果表明，对于病毒相关HCC患者，使用三磷酸胞苷二钠盐和鸟苷-5'-三磷酸作为辅助治疗，可能具有更好的预后。总之，本研究鉴定出对肝炎病毒具有致癌性的新型分子，有望作为诊断和治疗的分子标志物及靶点。
